body.text: SPEC UPDATE (user request) — before coding re-read /Users/manubaba/Documents/aegis-mcp/SPEC.md sections 'Multi-tenancy', 'Credentials' and 'Exact public APIs', plus the updated tests/contract.rs. Changes: (1) every person logs in: POST /api/login sets aegis_session cookie, POST /api/logout, GET /api/me {subject,display_name,mcp_token}; person-scoped APIs return 401 without session, 403 for another person's subject/request/receipt. (2) /mcp: Authorization: Bearer <Vault::mcp_token()> selects the person via aegis_core::vault_for_token (bad token -> HTTP 401); else x-aegis-user unless GatewayDeps.require_mcp_token (new bool field). aegis-core gained Vault::verify_password, Vault::mcp_token, vault_for_token. Reply 'ack' and proceed.
